title: Revoked Taxi Permit
summary:
*   A taxicab driver's permit was revoked following a recommendation from the Police Department.
*   The City Council convened for a brief 10-minute session.
*   The meeting was held on an alternate day due to the Mayor's planned absence from the city.
transcript:
RHOULAR MENTING OF THE CITY COUNCIL:
Austin, Texnя, July 07, 1943
The City Council convened in Regular Seasion, at the repular meeting place in the
Municipal Building, on Wednesday, July 7, 1943, nt 11:10 A. M., with Mayor Tom Miller
presiding; the meeting having been held on this day on account of the intended absence of
the Mayor from the City on the following Thursday, the regular meeting day. Roll coll
showed the following members presont: Councilmen Alford, Bartholomew, Gillin, and Mayor
Miller: absent, Councilman Wolf.
There were prosent also: Walter E. Senholm, Acting City Manager; J. E. Mothoral, City
Engineer; J. H. Patternon, Jr., Acting City Attorney; and R. D. Thorp, Chief of Police.
The minutes of the Regular Meeting of July 1, 1943, were read; and upon motion of
Councilman Alford, were adopted as read by the following vote! "Ayes," Councilmen Alford,
Bartholomew, Gillis, and Mayor Miller; "nays," none; Councilman Wolf absent.
It was moved by Councilman Alford that upon the recommendation of the Police Department
the taxicab driver's permit issued to Frodderic Constanti Verrell, being Permit #878, be
revoked.
The motion carried by the following vote: "ayes," Councilmen Alford, Bartholomew, Gillis,
and Mayor Miller: "naye," none; Councilman Wolf absent.
Upon motion, seconded and carried, the meeting was recessed at 11:20 A. M., subject to
call of the Mayor.
